label: Familiar Trouble
summary: Your first-year binding goes wrong and you bond with a storm spirit that should not exist, the week before House trials.
title: Familiar Trouble
description: Every first-year at the Saltmarsh Lyceum binds a small weather spirit: a breeze, a drizzle, a bit of fog. Yours was supposed to be a breeze. Instead, something enormous and crackling answered, and it is now living in your teapot. Binding a storm spirit is forbidden, House trials are in a week, and your roommate has noticed.

chapterOutlines.title: The Binding
chapterOutlines.outline: The binding ceremony goes wrong in the most spectacular way.

chapterOutlines.title: Hiding a Storm
chapterOutlines.outline: Keep your familiar secret through classes, rivals and a very nosy professor.

chapterOutlines.title: House Trials
chapterOutlines.outline: Compete in the trials with a storm in your pocket.

chapterOutlines.title: The Gale
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out who sent the storm spirit to you, and why.

scene.location: The binding circle on the Lyceum's sea cliff, at dawn
scene.summary: Thirty first-years stand in chalk circles, holding bowls of seawater. The wind is calm. It will not stay that way.

openThreads: Why did a storm spirit answer you?
Who is helping you, and who wants you expelled?

npcs.name: Odessa Finch
npcs.description: Your roommate, a fog-binder from a fishing family who has decided you are her best friend whether you like it or not.
goals: Win the Tide Cup for House Gull
abilities: Calls fog thick enough to hide a ship

npcs.name: Lucan Ashby-Vere
npcs.description: The top student of the year, from an old magical family, who has never been second at anything until now.

npcs.name: Professor Ida Marrow
npcs.description: A tiny, ancient professor with a bound hurricane she keeps in a jar on her desk. She notices everything.

items.name: Binding chalk
items.description: Sea-salt chalk for drawing binding circles.

items.name: Chipped teapot
items.description: Your storm familiar's favorite place to sleep. It rattles when it dreams.
